audit.whatIsWrong: The whole difficulty layer was inverted. diff said FAV but diffRating was 8.5/10, tone was the red #ff5d6c, and breakdown.difficulty / report[14] called it a hard matchup — against a 53.47% Emerald+ win rate over 909 games. The level chart was worse: six of seven rows read Lucian or Skill while the packet chart and the page's own whys text both describe Gragas taking levels 2 onward.
audit.why: 53.47% over 909 games is a favoured lane, and the prose already agrees: whys[1] says the level 2-3 sustain trade 'tips your way', whys[3] says W maxed out-sustains his poke, whys[4] calls level 6 your all-in spike, whys[5] says force every all-in on his E cooldown. Only levels 1 (his Piercing Light plus a Lightslinger double-shot before Happy Hour exists) and the two-item mark (crit and lifesteal kiting E resets) are not yours. The sides were contradicting the paragraphs printed directly beneath them.
audit.corrected: Level chart flipped to the packet chart as one atomic group: Lucian / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Skill, with ratings 3-6-5-7-7-7-5. diffRating 8.5/10 to 4/10, carryRating 8.5/10 to 7/10, tone to green, and every prose field carrying the 8.5 figure restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why described the level-6 and first-item spikes generically without naming what Cask actually does to Lucian, and phases[6].why quoted the wrong carry number.
audit.why: Lucian's only escape is Relentless Pursuit (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, 445 range). Explosive Cask is a 1000-range knockback on 100/85/70 — it is the tool that removes him from his own ult's firing line and cuts the dash escape. At two items he kites the telegraphed E-W-Q with dash resets, which is the real reason that row is not yours. spikes[] already has all four entries and reads accurately.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the E-flash stun, the fermented Q slow and the Cask displacement; phases[6].why now states the kiting problem instead of a stale rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown breakdown treated Relentless Pursuit as a fixed timer. It is not: the kit states Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown.
audit.why: This is the single most punishable-window claim on the page and it was wrong in the player's favour. Base 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot he lands shaves it, so a Lucian who is hitting you has it back well before the timer you counted. That changes when it is safe to Body Slam in on a 14s cooldown of your own.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the 16s base and the Lightslinger reduction stated.
sources: brief enemyKit E text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'

audit.why: Trading rules already key correctly off Drunken Rage's damage reduction (flat 5s cooldown) and the bait-the-dash pattern; the 13-second whiff figure sits inside the real 12-14s range.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Lucian contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is his: Piercing Light and a Lightslinger double-shot beat your one ability with no heal — last-hit at barrel range.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Lucian's Relentless Pursuit is down.
edits.after: Level 2 flips — Drunken Rage's damage cut plus Happy Hour eat his double-shot chip faster than he can apply it on a 9s Q.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lucian must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but he holds Relentless Pursuit to cancel your Body Slam and your W isn't maxed — neither side commits cleanly.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Relentless Pursuit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: W maxed and Happy Hour out-sustain his Q poke — bait the dash, Body Slam in, and W-empower the auto into the stun.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lucian's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is your spike: E-flash the stun, detonate a fermented Q for the slow, and Explosive Cask knocks him out of his own ult's firing line.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Lucian carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: he kites your combo with E resets in the open, so stop hunting the 1v1 — Cask him off your carries and Body Slam his step-up.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit's 16s and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Carry threat: 8.5/10. If Lucian gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 7/10. If Lucian gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot shaves it, so it returns early if he is hitting you. Track it. - Body Slam: never spend it on chip. - Cask: kill windows only.
